# k.compiler: Compiler and artifacts
status: implemented

**API.** One Vite plugin on oxc, no options. Project shape comes from module manifests, `routes.ts`, `tokens.ts`, and `topology.ts`.
```ts
// vite.config.ts (generated by scaffold)
import keel from '@keel/compiler/vite'
export default { plugins: [keel()] }
```

**Output.** JSX compiles to direct DOM operations (k.runtime); there is no virtual DOM and no diffing. A component function runs once per instance. Each dynamic expression becomes one binding (text, attribute, property, or event) that updates only its own node. Static subtrees are hoisted into templates built once and cloned. `If`, `For`, `Match`/`Case`, and `Boundary` are compiler intrinsics imported from `@keel/runtime-dom`; they lower to runtime ops, not component calls. `For` requires `key` naming a field of the item schema; when order changes, rows move rather than re-create.

**Escaping by context.** Text children always become text nodes. Attributes and properties are set through the DOM, never string-concatenated. Server HTML escapes text and attribute contexts separately. URL attributes (`href`, `src`, `action`, `formaction`) take an `Href` from `href()` (string paths are E1501, k.router) or an absolute URL; at runtime any scheme other than `http`, `https`, `mailto`, `tel` renders as `about:blank`. Raw HTML has no API outside `unsafe`.

**Artifacts.** Written to `.keel/` on every build and dev change. JSON, sorted keys, byte-identical for identical sources. Each file carries a content hash; all are read-only.
- `deps.json`: reactive graph, nodes and edges (k.reactive).
- `ids.json`: `{ [elementId]: { file, line, col, component, tag, role } }`, one entry per element (k.component ids).
- `routes.json`: `{ [routeId]: { path, params, search, actions, layout, guard, module } }`; schemas as JSON Schema.
- `a11y.json`: per element id, expected `role` and the source of its accessible name (`label`, `alt`, `text`, `aria`); read by `check` and the harness.

**Rules.** E1000 source does not parse (message is the parser error, under 90 chars) · E1001 `For` without `key`, or `key` not a field of the item · E1002 `innerHTML`, `outerHTML`, `insertAdjacentHTML`, or `dangerouslySetInnerHTML` in app code · E1003 literal `javascript:` or `data:` URL in a URL attribute · E1004 a `*.server.ts` module imported from client-reachable code (ADR-0006; evaluated per deployable: a file under `modules/<m>/` belongs to every deployable listing `m`; not reported when all of them declare no server, since a client-only build bundles loaders and actions to the browser, nor for the `routes.ts` of a module only `node` deployables list, which the server loads; files outside `modules/` such as tests, configs, and the server entry are never subject) · E1005 hand edit to generated output (`.keel/`, `turbo.json`, CI workflows, Dockerfiles, generated API schemas); fix: revert and regenerate.

**Conformance.**
- Compiling the same sources twice yields byte-identical JS and artifacts.
- Updating one signal changes only the DOM nodes bound to it; every other node keeps its identity.
- A string containing `<script>` or `"><img onerror=x>` rendered as a child or attribute value appears verbatim as text or attribute value and creates no element.
- A dynamic `href` whose value is `javascript:alert(1)` renders as `about:blank`.
- `ids.json` has exactly one entry per element in source, and each key is an id the harness `find(id)` resolves.
- Reordering a keyed `For` list preserves the DOM node identity of every row.
- Changing any byte of a file under `.keel/` makes `keel check` report E1005 on that file.
- A component with no dynamic expressions compiles to a single cloned template and no bindings.
